questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No Improvement.**

Mohan __is pleased__ at the news yesterday.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'was pleased'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **According to grammar** whenever we have the reference of past time we need to use the past indefinite tense in this sentence, 'was' is a linking verb and 'pleased' is an adjective that is used as a subject complement this makes the sentence correct.
 
• So the correct answer is **Option 1. **

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He ______ his portrait in the main hall.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'hung'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We cannot use** 'hanged'** and **'had hanged' **because** **it won't fit as per the context of the sentence.
 
• In situations where someone is given a death sentence, we use 'hanged'.
 
• Hang(V1)⇒Hung(V2)⇒Hung(V3) means to attach or place something so that it is held up without support from below.
 
• Hang(V1)⇒Hanged(V2)⇒Hanged(V3) means to die by being suspended by the neck.
 
• 'Hang' is incorrect because 'he' is singular so it must be followed with singular verb **hangs** which is not present in the given options. 

Hence, **Option 3** is the most suitable answer.

questions.question:

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

My teacher is the ______ of all.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'kindest'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The sentence refers to one teacher and her attribute among the others. Her kindness is the highest among all the teachers.

A superlative degree is used to choose one out of a group or many.

 
• Base form: kind
 
• Comparative: kinder
 
• Superlative: kindest

Thus** kindest** is the most suitable option.

questions.question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate word. Choose the correct alternative.

The bullet struck a wall and was ______ from its course.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Deflected'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the given words-
 
 
• **Twisted-** Form into bent.
 
• **Crashed-** Collide violently with an obstacle.
 
• **Deflected- **Deviate or cause to deviate.
 
• **Reflected-** Throwback (heat, light, or sound) without absorbing it.
 
 
 
• So the correct answer is 'Deflected'
 
• Also, in the given blank we need to use 'third form of the verb' because the linking verb 'was' has been used. 

**So the correct sentence is-** *The bullet struck a wall and was **deflected** from its course.*
